note: Canonical avatar registry — the 12 zodiac companions as pre-set characters. Fixed identity (name/animal/essence/look/poses) stays constant book to book; the year's Chinese element only tints the palette. `assets.sheet` is the registered reference portrait (Higgsfield / Recraft V4.1, house palette) that keeps a companion itself across every render; fill higgsfield_character_id / lora to lock consistency further. Story TEXT reads name+essence; ILLUSTRATION reads look+assets. Keep name/essence in sync with functions/api/generate.js and functions/api/illustrate.js. See AVATARS.md.
style: children's picture-book character reference, fine hand-drawn ink line in warm dark-brown (#2c2416) with gold-leaf accents (#c9a227) and soft watercolour washes on warm off-white paper (#faf7f0); gentle, rounded, tender — never cartoon-glossy, 3D, or scary
